title: BADF-WP-GIT-A2: GitHub Remote Workspace contract correction
objective: Upgrade the DESIGNED badf-git contract so BADF isolates work through GitHub-hosted topic refs and immutable commit/tree identities rather than local git worktrees, while preserving protected-main composition, evidence and authority boundaries.
business_value: Makes BADF Git suitable for cloud/agentic execution without relying on a persistent local filesystem, gives concurrent agents stable GitHub-native workspace identities, and reduces local-state ambiguity while retaining optimistic concurrency, exact-state evidence and protected integration controls.
